# CheevosRoms

> CheevosRoms (https://cheevosroms.vercel.app) helps RetroAchievements players find ROMs whose hash matches the one RetroAchievements recognizes, so achievements ("cheevos") actually unlock. It indexes 8,400+ games across 50+ consoles and links to files hosted on archive.org; it does not host any files itself.

Also known as: CheevoRoms, Cheevos Roms, RA Downloader (former name).

## What it does

- Search by game name or by RetroAchievements hash (MD5-style RA hash).
- Verify a hash: is it valid, is it recognized by RetroAchievements, and is the download link alive.
- Verify a local ROM file: the RA hash is computed in the browser, the file is never uploaded (cartridge systems only).
- Connect a RetroAchievements account to bring in your "Want to Play" list.
- Cart with batch download.
- Interface in Spanish, English, Portuguese and French.

## Notes

- Not affiliated with RetroAchievements.org.
- Downloads open on archive.org in the user's browser; logging in to archive.org first is recommended.
- Users should respect local laws and the terms of archive.org and RetroAchievements.
